references.text: The description of the breastpiece (choshen) and its design, including the Urim and Thummim, which Moses here places on Aaron according to God's command.
The making of the breastpiece by Bezalel and the craftsmen, which is now placed on Aaron.
Joshua was to stand before the priest Eleazar, who would inquire for him by means of the Urim judgment before the Lord.
Moses' blessing over the tribe of Levi mentions that the Thummim and Urim belong to the godly man (Aaron/the priests).
Saul asked the Lord, but the Lord did not answer him, neither by dreams, nor by Urim, nor by prophets.
Some could not eat from the most holy things until a priest appeared with the Urim and Thummim.
Parallel to Ezra 2:63 regarding waiting for a priest with the Urim and Thummim to decide doubtful questions.
